output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initial totalSupply is set to 0, and anyone can exploit this vulnerability to mint arbitrary amount of tokens to any user's balanceOf, due to the unprotected mintToken function.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value overflows, allowing the balanceOf[_to] to be set to a arbitrary value.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value overflows, allowing the balanceOf[_to] to be set to a arbitrary value.

The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the allowance[msg.sender][_spender] + _value overflows, allowing the allowance to be set to a arbitrary value.

The burn function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[msg.sender] - _value overflows, allowing the balanceOf[msg.sender] to be set to a arbitrary value.
